verdict.rationale: Ente Auth is a 2FA app backed by a syncing, self-hostable server, so an API reference is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence shows no interactive API reference or runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probes returned 404 on every candidate path. The export JSON-format docs, the CLI and llms.txt are adjacent features and do not count as an interactive API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
